selected_problem: Fresh canonical main now declares the durable changeset contract as taowind-code.changeset.v0.3, but apply/rollback still trusted any persisted protocol string as long as the remaining fields looked usable. A staged or applied artifact whose protocol was coherently rewritten to an unknown version would still be executed under v0.3 semantics.（最新主分支已经明确声明 v0.3 持久化契约，但 apply/rollback 仍忽略持久化 protocol；未知协议版本的工件仍会被按 v0.3 语义执行。）
decision_basis: The protocol identity is now an explicit checked-in contract and stage already emits it, so revalidating that same identity at effectful boundaries preserves existing semantics rather than choosing a new architecture.（协议身份已是仓库明确契约且 stage 已写入，本轮只在副作用边界重验同一语义。）

The defect is directly falsifiable by rewriting only doc.protocol after stage/apply: pre-fix apply and rollback both continued instead of rejecting the unknown protocol.（只改写 doc.protocol 即可直接复现：修复前 apply 与 rollback 均继续执行。）
changes: Centralize the current durable protocol string in CHANGESET_PROTOCOL and use it when staging documents.（集中定义当前持久化协议字符串，并由 stage 使用。）
Fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_CHANGESET_PROTOCOL before apply or rollback consumes a durable document whose protocol differs from v0.3.（apply/rollback 在消费未知协议工件前失败关闭。）
Add focused regressions for both apply and rollback protocol drift.（新增覆盖应用与回滚两条路径的协议漂移回归。）

truth_boundary: This ensures current v0.3 semantics are not applied to an artifact that declares another protocol. It does not authenticate the whole durable artifact, provide protocol migration, or make multi-file apply crash-atomic.（本轮防止未知协议工件被按 v0.3 执行；不认证整个持久化工件、不提供协议迁移，也不声称多文件应用具备崩溃原子性。）
